newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed after range trade.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo rubber futures end mixed after range trade.

text.p: Tokyo rubber futures ended mixed on Monday, after drifting within tight ranges in directionless trade, traders said.
Prices ranged from 0.5 yen per kg lower to 1.2 yen firmer. The benchmark September was off 0.5 yen at 135.8 yen.
Private investors were wary of taking fresh positions ahead of the spot expiry on Wednesday.
Sentiment remained bearish as there were no bullish factors in sight. Traders said market players may be unwilling to accept deliveries on Wednesday due to quality problems.
